description: Read queries reported by the connected React Query integration, including available status, observer counts, timestamps and errors. includeData:true requests cached payloads; staleOnly:true filters stale queries. Use each returned hash with react_query_action. History depends on retained events.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

includeData.description: Include each query's full cached data payload (HEAVY). Default false.

name: get_react_query
